thread:
maria: Quick release-train bulletin — planned capacity rebalance + clarified freeze rules for this week. Please skim. :eyes:

maria: TL;DR: rolling GPU pool rebalance Tue 02:00–06:00 UTC; partial release freeze for high-risk lanes Wed 00:00–Thu 08:00 UTC. Low-risk fixes may ship with approval. Canary windows moved to Thu 10:00–14:00 UTC.

kevin: what exactly counts as 'high-risk lane'?

maria: high-risk = model topology or weights, quant changes, runtime/kernels, KV cache behavior, major routing changes. Anything touching inference path. Docs, infra config, small non-model patches are low-risk but still need a quick checklist.

alex: new rollback/abort thresholds?

maria: yes — automatic abort if canary 5xx increases by >= 3% absolute or >2x baseline for 10m. Also tail latency >150% baseline for 3 consecutive mins triggers manual pause. Snippet of the rule: 

``nif (canary_5xx_rate >= baseline + 0.03 || canary_5xx_rate >= baseline*2) {
  abort_canary_rollout()
}
if (p95_latency >= baseline_p95*1.5 for 3m) {
  pause_rollout_and_alert_sre()
}
```

jamie: will the deploy tooling enforce labels/guards?

deploy-bot: Deploy guardrails ON for this train. Merges to release/* that touch models are blocked unless PR includes label `gated` and a signed-off rollout plan. I will post blocked PRs here. :robot_face:

sre-oncall: SRE will run extra tracing during the canary and monitor tail latency + memory pressure. If we see >10% increase in mem delta across GPUs or OOM anomalies we'll cut traffic.

kevin: exception path? emergency fixes?

maria: Exceptions allowed but require: (1) short rationale in release thread, (2) owner & rollback plan, (3) approval from @eng-leads and @sre-oncall. Emergency exception needs 2 leads + SRE ack. Approvals will be recorded in the freeze-exceptions doc.

alex: will Dedicated customers be affected?

maria: Dedicated pools will undergo node rebalancing; we mark SLA as best-effort during the window. Account teams notified; CS will post customer impact notices.

kevin: canary ownership this week? who runs the checks?

maria: release captain this train: @kevin — coordinate with SRE for golden prompts and tracing hooks. Run the standard regression + 10 smoke prompts targeting common failure modes.

kevin: got it. I'll drop a canary checklist in this channel by Tue EOD.

sre-oncall: quick ops note — enable extra perf sampling for canary: export PERF_PROF=1 and bump pprof interval to 10s.

jamie: will we use the new quant profile on canary or keep prod quant?

maria: keep existing prod quant for canary. New quant profiles must go through an isolated experiment (not part of this train).

kevin: any changes to incident paging thresholds?

sre-oncall: paging same for now, but we added a temporary alert: if gen tail latency p99 > 2s above baseline for 5m, page oncall immediately.

alex: deploy-bot, schedule the maintenance window?

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: 2028-07-12T02:00Z - 2028-07-12T06:00Z. Guardrails will be active at 2028-07-12T00:00Z.

maria: thanks — if there are no objections we'll lock high-risk lanes at 2028-07-12T00:00Z. I'll post the rollback playbook and the link to the freeze-exceptions doc shortly. :rocket:

kevin: ack

jamie: ack

alex: ack

maria: one last ask — release captains, add your golden prompt results as comments on the canary PR so we can track regressions over time.

kevin: will do.
